name: 30153 · Rockmart, GA
findings: ZIP 30153 (Rockmart) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30153 (Rockmart) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
